== Description ==
Original (2005) Players Committee slip of [[Restricted Access (V) (Virtual Set 11: Gathering Storm) (Original 2005)|Restricted Access (V)]], as printed on the first [[Virtual Set 11: Gathering Storm]] sheet (VirtualCards11.pdf, PDF created 21 December 2005), before the December 2006 Remaster. The printed label above the slip is included.

== Source and credit ==
* Source document: [[Media:Original_Virtual_Set_11_card_slips.pdf|Original Virtual Set 11 card slips.pdf]] ([[:File:Original Virtual Set 11 card slips.pdf|file page]]), PDF page 2, slip 28 (printed collector mark 11•28). The PDF (SHA-1 4718f51caad45785cd5effd7da77c6c799a52c89) is the wiki copy of Players Committee forum attachment 16604 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/download/file.php?id=16604 VirtualCards11.pdf]), posted by Throdo in [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1047093#p1047093 Original 17 VSet PDFs & Pre-Reset Block PDFs], 13 July 2016. Preserved copy of the post: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261124031108/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1047093.html Internet Archive]. Preserved copy of the PDF: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261123184931/https://swccg.com/wiki/images/f/fb/Original_Virtual_Set_11_card_slips.pdf Internet Archive].
* Derivation: PDF page 2 rendered at 300 dpi (poppler pdftoppm), the slip with its printed label cut out (pixel box 1660,1432–2416,1883 of the 2550 × 3300 render) and saved as PNG. Nothing else was changed.
* Publisher: the Players Committee, 2005. Original card imagery © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. Fair use: the image identifies the published card on this non-commercial fan wiki.
